title: Does John Conway hate his Game of Life?
summary: John Conway talks in a short Numberphile interview about his mixed feelings toward the Game of Life, his most famous invention. He says he is not especially pleased that it overshadowed his other work.
why: Cited whenever commenters want to note that Conway did not enjoy being known mainly for the Game of Life.

quote.text: Conway has said GOL is not something he is particularly pleased got as famous as it did.
